settings.title: Buy the consult
settings.text: ₹99, through the normal cart — it looks like any other purchase.

settings.title: Pick your slot
settings.text: Booking link arrives on WhatsApp and email. Phone or video, your choice.

settings.title: Talk openly
settings.text: A registered doctor, alone or with your partner. Nothing you say leaves the call.

settings.title: Get the plan
settings.text: Written plan within 24 hours — formulations, practice, and follow-up schedule.

settings.question: Is the consultation really private?
settings.answer: Yes. Calls are one-to-one with the doctor, records are confidential, and nothing appears on your phone bill except a normal call.

settings.question: What if I need medicines after?
settings.answer: The doctor's written plan lists exactly what is recommended and why. You order only what you choose to — there is no pressure and no auto-billing.
